name: Rhino Wire Works, LLC
old_description: At Rhino Wire Works, clients can request custom wire forms, bringing their ideas to life in collaboration with our skilled engineers. We meticulously craft each wire form to meet specific requirements, turning imagination into tangible, high-quality results for industrial, commercial, and artistic purposes.
about:
Rhino Wire Works operates from Delavan, Wisconsin, where it was established in January 1994 by John Burgstede as JB Wire Service, Inc. Burgstede brought over 40 years of experience from his uncle's wire forming and stamping business, joined by George Jeninga for a combined 70-plus years in the trade. The company was acquired in 2024 by Jonathan Zepeda, who adds two decades in steel and metals, while Burgstede remains involved in operations.

The shop specializes in custom wire forms, handling projects from prototype through production runs for OEM and service parts. Its core capability is wire bending, quoting from prints, sketches, or samples, and it also designs and builds custom paint-line fixtures and hooks—sold under the Rhino Hooks brand—to increase line density and solve hanging issues. For secondary operations such as machining or finishing, the firm coordinates with local machine shops.

Customers span industrial, commercial, and artistic sectors, ranging from large OEMs to small businesses needing custom brackets, hangers, or decorative wire work. The company emphasizes fast quotes, quick delivery, competitive pricing, and dependable service as its operating pillars.

The business began from Burgstede's deep trade background and was later transitioned to Zepeda to preserve quality and continuity for existing clients while expanding capabilities in wire forming and fixture design.
